verdict.rationale: Lever documents an AI matching feature (Talent Fit) that surfaces high-potential candidates using AI-powered matching and customizable criteria, but there is no documentation of how the matching algorithm works, what data it uses, or what safeguards/bias mitigations apply to automated candidate screening decisions. Missing for 10: technical explanation of the matching model, bias/fairness safeguards, human-in-the-loop or override mechanisms, and any compliance/audit documentation specific to automated hiring decisions.
